challenged_claim: The diagonal constant pi also bounds every target quadratic form.
correction: Six independent Uniform[-1/2,1/2] inputs and Q=((X1+X2)^2+(X3+X4)^2-(X5+X6)^2)/2 give eigenvalues 1,1,-1,0,0,0 and a continuous density with p_Q(0)=2pi-7/3>pi. A block-CLT interval-domination argument strengthens the necessary universal constant to C>=3sqrt(2). The valid diagonal pi theorem is unchanged; the full existence conjecture is not refuted.
supporting_upper_bound: For any original-coordinate cross block of rank r>2 with product Delta of all nonzero singular values, ||p_Q||infinity <= (2r/(r-2))*Delta^(-1/r). Thus rank-exactly-three A=U Lambda U^T with all |lambda_j|>=1 and max row leverage<=1/12 has a continuous density bounded by24. Mixed leverage and general higher-rank matrices are not covered.
